::: {#sol-repeat-trace}

| $(i, j)$ | $A[i]$ | $A[j]$ | `found` after the comparison |
|:--------:|:------:|:------:|:----------------------------:|
| $(1, 2)$ | 3      | 1      | false                        |
| $(1, 3)$ | 3      | 4      | false                        |
| $(1, 4)$ | 3      | 1      | false                        |
| $(2, 3)$ | 1      | 4      | false                        |
| $(2, 4)$ | 1      | 1      | true                         |
| $(3, 4)$ | 4      | 1      | true                         |

The inner loop compares the six pairs in the table, in that order.
`found` first becomes true at $(2, 4)$, since $A[2] = A[4] = 1$,
and it stays true, so `has_repeat` returns true.

:::
